description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube
- **Video quality toasts:** The "Show a toast when Shorts quality changes" switch now controls only Shorts, and "Show a toast when video quality changes" controls only regular videos. Before, the Shorts switch did nothing and the video switch controlled both. If you had turned off the video quality toast, turn off the Shorts one too to keep Shorts toasts off; existing choices are not copied.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54** (no change).

Not device-verified: both toast switches off, the old-style Shorts quality flyout, and the mobile-data variant.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.32.1...v1.32.2)
